name: Rat Catching
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
We have a real infestation problem to the west.  Tunnel rat kobolds have moved into the foothills, setting up dens and fouling our land with their filth!

We want them eliminated.  Hunt them, bring me their ears and earn their bounty.

You can find tunnel rat kobolds and their dens west of Thelsamar, littered along the mountainside.
narrative.objectives: Bring 12 Tunnel Rat Ears to Mountaineer Kadrell in Thelsamar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ugh! When I asked for those ears I didn't realize they'd smell so bad!

Here's your reward, adventurer. Well done.
narrative.requestItemsText: Hail, adventurer. How goes the rat catching?
